query:
SELECT
            app.provider,
            app.page_kind,
            app.address,
            app.role,
            pp.fetched_at,
            pp.is_dead,
            pp.missing_since
        FROM anime_provider_page app
        JOIN provider_page pp
          ON pp.provider = app.provider
         AND pp.page_kind = app.page_kind
         AND pp.address = app.address
        WHERE app.anime_id = $1
        ORDER BY app.role, app.provider, app.address
